items.title: Marty Sheller interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, May 9, 2022
items.q: I did one arrangement on that album... but Bob, Robert Mercy did all the rest.

ctx.x: I did one arrangement on that album. I did an arrangement of “Walk on By” on that album but Bob, Robert Mercy did all the rest. And as a matter of fact, Mongo, when he signed with them he said he wanted to do a typical Latin album using different rhythms. And they said, “Well no, let Bob Mercy, we want him to do an album, and then we promise that after that then you can do what you want to do.” And the second one was an album that Mongo did, I’m trying to think the name of it, I can see the cover, a green cover…

Back to these Latin rhythms for a moment, I play on occasion for ballroom dancers and they will come up and they’ll want a cha-cha and then a rumba and etcetera. Am I correct that the exact tempo is really important in playing these rhythms?
